instruction: Proofread the document. Fix the known spelling, grammar, punctuation, word-choice, and style mistakes while preserving meaning, tone, paragraph ids, and intentional wording everywhere else.

issues.description: Reorders a modifier so that "undergoing elective or emergency surgery" incorrectly attaches to "hospital" instead of "patients," creating a misplaced modifier.

expectedCorrection.find: that care for patients within an average-sized new-build acute general hospital undergoing elective or emergency surgery as in-patients
expectedCorrection.replace: that care for patients undergoing elective or emergency surgery as in-patients within an average-sized new-build acute general hospital

issues.description: Introduces a nonparallel item in a coordinated series by changing a noun phrase to an adverbial phrase.

expectedCorrection.find: This helps with flexibility of operation, staffing efficiently, clinical governance
expectedCorrection.replace: This helps with flexibility of operation, efficiency of staffing, clinical governance

issues.description: Introduce a non-parallel first item in the coordinated infinitive list by changing the first verb phrase to a gerund phrase.

expectedCorrection.replace: The rationale is to preserve beds, reduce pressure on surgical wards

issues.description: Introduces an accidental repeated infinitive, creating an unnatural and hard-to-process phrase.
